scope: offline long-only research sidecar only; no live inference, admission, portfolio, policy, exchange, or model artifact mutation
purpose: restore individual canonical ten-head and shadow-ten-head outputs that were projected away by the lock-step aggregate ledger

source_contract.historical_candidate_population: each persisted target-free held-score receipt; later repaired source-panel supersets are filtered back to that immutable candidate identity set

output_contract.individual_head_fields: 40: raw and rank for ten canonical conditional-usefulness heads plus ten ordinary-shadow heads

august_extension.status: target-free scored feature receipts appended through 2026-08-16T10:00:00Z; source-vintage-labelled and intentionally not claimed as aggregate-parity historical blocks

tests.smoke: single persisted 2024-04-01 block: 47,228 rows, all 40 individual head fields, exact aggregate parity
tests.boundary_smoke: 2024-12-09 final-2024 receipt: 63,870 rows, exact identity and consensus parity despite later source-panel candidate superset

causality: Only point-in-time candidate identities and declared causal feature fields are passed into frozen upstream head predictors. Policy outcomes and label columns are neither selected nor read by the scorer. Per-head ranks use each head's frozen training score reference, not a held-period percentile.
